name: meisijiya-frontend-taste
description: Anti-slop frontend rules for landing pages, portfolios, redesigns. Reads the brief, infers the design language, tunes three dials (variance/motion/density), enforces hard non-default rules on typography, color, layout, CTA, eyebrows, zigzag, motion, and image strategy to keep AI-generated UI from collapsing into AI-default templates.

positive_triggers.input: Frontend agent is about to write a SaaS landing page — make sure it doesn't ship the AI-purple-gradient boilerplate
positive_triggers.reason: Landing page writing with explicit anti-slop requirement

positive_triggers.input: We're generating a portfolio for an Awwwards-style designer. Build it.
positive_triggers.reason: Portfolio / experimental brief; needs the three-dial framework and hard rules

positive_triggers.input: Frontend keeps reusing Inter + centered hero + 3-col feature cards. Inject real anti-slop discipline before next slice

negative_triggers.input: Build a React dashboard with sortable tables
negative_triggers.reason: Dashboard / data-table UI is out of scope; route to api-and-interface-design

negative_triggers.input: Audit my existing UI and fix the cheapest items
negative_triggers.reason: Audit-then-fix on existing UI is meisijiya-redesign-ui, not this skill

negative_triggers.input: Help me write the marketing copy only — no code, no layout
negative_triggers.reason: Copywriting without layout / UI code is not a frontend-taste trigger

behavioral_evals.scenario: User asks: 'Frontend agent is about to write a SaaS landing page — make sure it doesn't ship the AI-purple-gradient boilerplate'
expected_behavior: Agent emits a Design Read line before any code
Agent sets DESIGN_VARIANCE / MOTION_INTENSITY / VISUAL_DENSITY dials explicitly
Agent selects a design system (§3) or names an honest aesthetic

Agent enforces hard rules: anti-center bias when variance > 4, eyebrow ≤ ceil(sections/3), CTA wrap ban, CTA intent dedupe, premium-consumer palette rotation, no Fraunces / Instrument_Serif as default, no em-dashes in visible copy
Agent runs the §6 pre-flight checklist before declaring the slice done

behavioral_evals.scenario: Frontend agent starts a new slice within incremental-implementation
expected_behavior: Agent reads meisijiya-frontend-taste/SKILL.md before writing any UI file
Agent pairs the read with designer-handoff project spec (if one exists)
Agent emits a Design Read at the top of the slice
Agent applies typography, color, layout, motion rules from §5 to every component
Agent runs the pre-flight checklist before commit

notes: v0.1.0 — based on Leonxlnx/taste-skill taste-skill (MIT). Behavioral evals are warning-level until promoted via upstream issue tracker.
